abilities.text: During your turn, your opponents can't cast spells or activate abilities of artifacts, creatures, or enchantments.

rulings.text: Grand Abolisher doesn't stop your opponents from activating abilities of artifact, creature, or entorchantment cards in zones other than the battlefield (like cycling abilities, for example).
